flows: SFT trains on fixed teacher or dataset completions with dense next-token loss.
RL samples current student rollouts and optimizes sparse verifier or reward signal.
OPD samples current student rollouts, scores sampled tokens with a same-family teacher, and updates the student with dense teacher-derived advantages.
OPSD uses a privileged-context version of the student as teacher, which solves family mismatch but can concentrate gradients.
gaps: The nrehiew_ article page says the local X export did not include a clean static article body, so the page is grounded in saved article figures plus local reconstruction rather than a verbatim text archive.
The figures cite results from minimal editing, MiMo-V2-Flash, and thinking-mode KL analyses; the underlying primary papers are not all linked as separately ingested wiki pages.
